expectations_source: Entered in the app (preseason market win totals)
method: Player stats projected to an 82-game pace (games, minutes and counting totals scaled by 82 / team games). Projected team wins = the betting market’s expected final wins from sportsbook over/under win totals (lean priced in); league and conference positions and seeds rank teams by those wins. Scored with each award’s final model fitted on all completed seasons. Shares are model shares within the candidate pool, not calibrated odds.

odds.method: Equal-weight mean of raw implied probabilities from Sportsbet, Neds, Polymarket and Kalshi where listed. No margin adjustment or field normalisation. Original quoted decimal odds and retrieval times are retained.

movement.method: python3 fetch_odds_history.py [--year 2027] Sportsbet/Neds use the last observed decimal quote per UTC day; no invented pre-snapshot history.

MIP.eligibility_note: MIP eligibility: at least 13 PPG this season. Historical comparisons apply the same cutoff using the original prior-season fitted weights.

oddschecker.error: No saved Oddschecker chart snapshot for this award.

conference_standings.method: Ranked by the same projected final wins used in the award models: sportsbook win totals first, Basketball Reference projected records second, current record pace last. Ties use current win percentage then team code; these are not official NBA tiebreakers.

all_stars.eligibility: At least 5 games played, 40% of the team’s games, and 15 minutes per game so far.
all_stars.method: A statistical selection score, not a fitted voting probability: 30% scoring, 25% BPM, 15% WS/48, 10% assists, 10% rebounds, 5% availability and 5% current team record (win percentage). Player performance inputs use league-wide eligible-player percentiles; current team win percentage is ranked across all 30 teams; availability is the fraction of team games played. Five highest scores are starters, the next seven form the bench, and the next five are honourable mentions. No positional quotas are imposed. Missing rate inputs use the eligible-pool median. Fan/player/media voting, injuries and event-team assignments are not predicted.
